notes: Read from the project's GitHub repository (README and LICENSE.md, the CC BY-SA 4.0 text), which is the course's home; the GitHub Pages site (dabeaz-course.github.io) was not reachable and was not read, and there is no separate terms page. CC BY-SA 4.0 allows commercial use, so a paid app may show a passage with the credit in attribution; changes Ceder makes must be shared under the same licence. The README's statement is about the course as a whole; it does not list third-party items, so a data file or image from elsewhere in the repository was not checked. It is a course for people who already program ("not a course for absolute beginners"), so it suits a second programming course, not a first. The same author's python-mastery course is a different work and was not read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
